name: Match
definition: A single competitive football fixture between two teams, identified by Match.match_api_id and uniquely stored in the Match table.
scope: european_football_2; the central fact table of the football domain

name: Team
definition: A football club that can appear as the home or away side of a match and carries both a long and a short display name.
scope: european_football_2; 299 clubs across 11 national leagues

name: Player
definition: A footballer with a name, a FIFA identifier, a birth date, a height and a weight, who can be selected in a match lineup.
scope: european_football_2; 11060 players

name: League
definition: A national top-division competition, identified by League.id and named in League.name, to which each match belongs.
scope: european_football_2; 11 leagues

name: Country
definition: The country associated with a league, stored in the Country table and referenced by League.country_id.
scope: european_football_2; 11 countries

name: Season
definition: The competition year label used by this database, a TEXT value of the form 'YYYY/YYYY' naming a start and an end year.
scope: european_football_2; eight values from 2008/2009 to 2015/2016

name: Match Stage
definition: The integer round or matchday index within a league season, from 1 up to the number of rounds that the league's fixture list produces.
scope: european_football_2; Match.stage takes integer values 1..38

name: Home/Away Role
definition: Which of the two participating sides a match row describes, expressed in this database through the home_-prefixed and away_-prefixed column pairs rather than through a role column.
scope: european_football_2; applies to team, goal and player-slot columns of Match

name: Match Outcome
definition: The result of a match from one side's perspective: win, draw or loss, determined by comparing the goals that side scored with the goals it conceded.
scope: european_football_2; derived from the scoreline columns, not stored as a column

name: Goal
definition: A single scoring event, counted for the side that benefits from it; goals are the atomic unit behind every scoreline in the database.
scope: european_football_2; stored only as an aggregate per side in the scoreline columns

name: Team Goals For
definition: The number of goals a given team scored across a chosen scope of matches, taking the home or away scoreline column according to that team's role in each match.
scope: european_football_2; aggregation scope is any set of matches

name: Team Goals Against
definition: The number of goals a given team conceded across a chosen scope of matches, taking the scoreline column belonging to its opponent in each match.
scope: european_football_2; aggregation scope is any set of matches

name: Goal Difference
definition: Team goals for minus team goals against over the same scope of matches, used as a measure of dominance independent of the number of matches played.
scope: european_football_2; meaningful only within a fixed league and season scope

name: League Points
definition: The competition points a team accumulates from match outcomes within a league season, conventionally three for a win, one for a draw and zero for a loss.
scope: european_football_2; the point award rule is not encoded anywhere in the database

name: Home Advantage
definition: The tendency for the side playing at its own ground to achieve better outcomes and score more goals than the visiting side over a comparable set of matches.
scope: european_football_2; measurable by comparing home-side and away-side outcome rates

name: Team API Identifier
definition: The identifier used by the match and team tables to link a team consistently across fixtures and team attribute snapshots.
scope: european_football_2; Team.team_api_id, Match.home_team_api_id, Match.away_team_api_id, Team_Attributes.team_api_id

name: Team FIFA Identifier
definition: The alternative team identifier carried both on the team record and on every team attribute snapshot, absent for a small number of teams.
scope: european_football_2; Team.team_fifa_api_id, Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id

name: Player API Identifier
definition: The identifier used by the player table, the match lineup slots and the player attribute snapshots to link a player consistently.
scope: european_football_2; Player.player_api_id, Match.home_player_1..11 and away_player_1..11, Player_Attributes.player_api_id

name: Player FIFA Identifier
definition: The alternative player identifier carried both on the player record and on every player attribute snapshot.
scope: european_football_2; Player.player_fifa_api_id, Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id

name: Player Overall Rating
definition: A single summary quality score for a player at a point in time, recorded on the player attribute snapshot.
scope: european_football_2; observed values run from 33 to 94

name: Player Potential
definition: An upper-bound quality score for a player at a point in time, recording how good the player is judged likely to become.
scope: european_football_2; observed values run from 39 to 97

name: Player Skill Attribute
definition: One of the 33 granular per-player ability scores on a player attribute snapshot, covering technical, mental and physical facets of outfield and goalkeeping play.
scope: european_football_2; observed values run from 1 to 98 on a bounded rating scale

name: Goalkeeper Skill Attribute
definition: The subset of player skill attributes that describe goalkeeping ability specifically, namely diving, handling, kicking, positioning and reflexes.
scope: european_football_2; present on every player snapshot, but only meaningful for goalkeepers

name: Player Physical Profile
definition: The recorded body measurements of a player, stored as a height and a weight on the player record.
scope: european_football_2; height recorded in centimetres, weight recorded in pounds

name: Player Age
definition: A player's completed years between the recorded birth date and the date of the observation, which for attribute questions must be the snapshot date rather than a fixed current date.
scope: european_football_2; derived from Player.birthday and a comparison date

name: Work Rate
definition: A categorical descriptor of how intensively a player contributes to attacking and to defensive phases, held in two separate snapshot columns.
scope: european_football_2; both columns contain values outside the intended vocabulary

name: Preferred Foot
definition: Which foot a player favours, recorded as a two-value categorical descriptor on the player attribute snapshot.
scope: european_football_2; values observed left and right, plus empty entries

name: Player Attribute Snapshot
definition: A dated record of one player's ratings and skill attributes, so that a player's ability is represented as a time series of point-in-time measurements rather than a single current value.
scope: european_football_2; Player_Attributes, keyed by player_api_id together with date

name: Team Playing Style Profile
definition: The dated set of tactical descriptors characterising how a team builds up play, creates chances and defends, recorded together on a single snapshot row.
scope: european_football_2; Team_Attributes, available for only six snapshot dates

name: Team Style Metric
definition: One of the numeric tactical intensity scores on a team snapshot, spanning build-up, chance creation and defensive dimensions on a bounded scale.
scope: european_football_2; nine numeric columns on Team_Attributes

name: Team Style Class
definition: The categorical band that accompanies each numeric team style metric, splitting the metric's range into a small set of labelled levels.
scope: european_football_2; twelve class columns on Team_Attributes

name: Team Attribute Snapshot
definition: A dated record of one team's tactical profile, so that team style is represented as a sparse time series of measurements rather than a current value.
scope: european_football_2; Team_Attributes, six dates between 2010 and 2015

name: Betting Odds
definition: The pre-match decimal prices offered by a bookmaker for the three match outcomes of home win, draw and away win, held as three adjacent columns per bookmaker.
scope: european_football_2; eleven bookmakers on the Match table, coverage varies by bookmaker

name: Bookmaker
definition: The betting operator whose prices are recorded, represented in this database by a short alphabetic prefix on the odds columns rather than by a stored name or key.
scope: european_football_2; eleven prefixes observed on the Match table

name: Implied Probability
definition: The probability of an outcome that a decimal price implies, obtained as the reciprocal of that price and summing to slightly more than one across the three outcomes because of the bookmaker margin.
scope: european_football_2; derived from the odds columns, never stored

name: Match Event Log
definition: The XML-like per-match event feed recording individual goals, shots, fouls, cards, crosses, corners and possession readings, stored as one text block per event family in a separate column.
scope: european_football_2; eight columns on Match, jointly absent for a large share of matches

name: Goal Type
definition: The short code attached to a goal event classifying how the goal came about, drawn from a fixed but undocumented code set.
scope: european_football_2; seven distinct codes observed in the goal event feed

name: Card Type
definition: The short code attached to a disciplinary event classifying the sanction shown to a player.
scope: european_football_2; three distinct codes observed in the card event feed

name: Possession Reading
definition: A point-in-time share of ball possession attributed to the home side and to the away side, recorded at intervals during a match.
scope: european_football_2; encoded inside the possession event feed, not stored as a match column

name: Starting Lineup
definition: The eleven players fielded by one side in a match, stored as eleven player reference slots laid out per side on the match row.
scope: european_football_2; 22 player slots per match, incomplete for a small share of matches

name: Player Position Coordinate
definition: The grid coordinate pair recorded for each lineup slot, giving that player's lateral and depth position on the pitch for the match.
scope: european_football_2; 44 coordinate columns on Match, jointly absent for a small share of matches

name: Formation
definition: The shape a side played, reconstructed by grouping the eleven lineup position coordinates into depth lines and counting how many players occupied each line.
scope: european_football_2; derived from the position coordinates, never stored
